Nightfall adaptation to Dark Reader 4.9.133 (MIT).

The upstream ignoreImageAnalysis selector exclusion returns the entire original
background-image declaration, skipping both URL images and CSS gradients. With
image analysis enabled, upstream may hide large light photographic backgrounds.

scripts/build.cjs applies four checked replacements at build time:
1. Keep the exclusion flag but continue parsing gradients, including inline
   declarations without a stylesheet selector.
2. In the URL modifier, return the original absolute URL when excluded, without
   analysing, recolouring or hiding it. Empty URL values stay empty.
3. Let inline gradient-plus-URL declarations reach the modifier rather than
   skipping the whole declaration as the upstream inline handler does.
4. Resolve inline relative URLs against document.baseURI rather than the origin.

Nightfall uses ignoreImageAnalysis: ['*']. Thus URL image data stays original,
while gradient stops and ordinary surface/text colours are converted normally.

The npm dependency is unmodified. The build fails if the version or any exact
source anchor changes, requiring a deliberate patch review for upgrades. The
upstream copyright and licence remain in darkreader.js and DARKREADER-LICENSE.
